status.description: Initial state of the submitted video generation job or pre-flight validation status

spec_path.description: Absolute POSIX path to the resolved scenario specification file (.json)

is_valid.description: Whether scenario pre-flight validation passed (present when dry_run=true)

total_duration.description: Calculated total duration of the scenario in seconds (present when dry_run=true)

scenes_count.description: Total number of scenes in scenario (present when dry_run=true)

blocks_count.description: Total number of continuous motion blocks across scenes (present when dry_run=true)

warnings.description: Optional non-fatal warnings collected during dry-run validation
